authority_limit: Expert work constrains candidates; it does not make the author SAN's semantic owner.
learnable_design_laws: Do not force multi-entity behavior into one inherent case.
Keep entity-scoped directly-follows paths and aggregation provenance explicit.
Treat OCED construction, semantic depth and graph/query layers as separate decisions.
name: Dirk Fahland

authority_limit: Foundational scholarship is evidence, not enterprise decision authority.
learnable_design_laws: Separate discovery, conformance, enhancement and operational support.
Preserve object-centric relations rather than manufacturing a single case identifier.
Make analysis perspective and method assumptions explicit.
name: Wil M. P. van der Aalst

authority_limit: Research participation does not ratify SAN contracts.
learnable_design_laws: Separate a stable event-data core from conventions and extensions.
Dynamic relationships need explicit temporal assumptions.
Do not standardize ambiguous constructs merely because implementations can encode them.
name: Marco Montali

authority_limit: Implementations and papers do not own downstream domain state definitions.
learnable_design_laws: Keep exchange-format validation executable across carriers.
Model state-aware enrichment as a derived projection with a declared leading object and state function.
Retain reproducible fixtures and transformation artifacts.
name: Alessandro Berti

authority_limit: The method does not select an enterprise's states or thresholds.
learnable_design_laws: Make object states and transitions explicit when diagnostics depend on them.
Distinguish a transition event from an ordinary event enriched with state context.
State meaning remains domain-specific and perspective-dependent.
name: Dina Kretzschmann

authority_limit: A tEKG transformation is one qualified representation, not universal graph semantics.
learnable_design_laws: Preserve changing object attributes through temporal entity snapshots.
Specify OCEL-to-graph transformation semantics and modes.
Record projection loss instead of treating graph conversion as identity.
name: Shahrzad Khayatbashi

authority_limit: Temporal-graph expertise does not confer process or operational authority.
learnable_design_laws: Temporal graph semantics belong in the model, not only timestamp properties.
Separate data transformation correctness from analytical interpretation.
Version graph representations and transformation laws independently.
name: Olaf Hartig

authority_limit: A conformance algorithm does not decide compliance or sanctions.
learnable_design_laws: Distinguish heuristic replay from exhaustive/optimal alignment.
Bind conformance outcomes to a specific model, mapping and cost profile.
Expose computational trade-offs and typed incompleteness.
name: Josep Carmona
